displayDescription.en:
LLaMA introduced a family of 7B to 65B parameter foundation language models trained on publicly available datasets. The work emphasized that smaller models trained on more tokens could deliver strong inference-time efficiency and competitive benchmark performance.

The release gave researchers access to capable base models at several scales and accelerated work on adaptation, quantization and instruction tuning.
displayDescription.zh:
LLaMA 推出一组参数规模从 70 亿到 650 亿的基础语言模型，并在公开可用数据集上训练。该工作强调：让较小模型看到更多训练 token，可以兼顾较强基准表现与更高推理效率。

这次发布让研究者能够在多个规模上使用有能力的基础模型，并加速了适配、量化和指令微调研究。

html.en: Frontier language models were becoming larger and less accessible, while scaling-law research showed that parameter count alone did not determine compute-efficient training. LLaMA explored how smaller base models trained on more tokens could remain capable while being less expensive to run.
html.zh: 前沿语言模型不断变大且越来越难以获取，而缩放规律研究表明，参数量并不是计算高效训练的唯一决定因素。LLaMA 探索了较小基础模型在更多 token 上训练后，如何保持能力并降低运行成本。

html.en: The team trained decoder-only transformers at four sizes using a large mixture of publicly available text and code. More training tokens were allocated to the smaller models, making the 7B and 13B variants practical research targets rather than merely reduced versions of the largest model.
html.zh: 团队使用大规模公开文本与代码混合数据，训练了四种规模的纯解码器 Transformer。较小模型获得更多训练 token，使 70 亿和 130 亿参数版本成为实用研究对象，而不只是最大模型的缩小版。

html.en: Experts generally treat the first LLaMA release as a turning point for research on adaptable foundation models outside a small set of hosted APIs. Its compact checkpoints catalyzed instruction tuning, low-rank adaptation, quantization and a broad open-model ecosystem, even though the original weights were released under research-oriented access terms.
html.zh: 专家通常把第一代 LLaMA 视为可适配基础模型研究走出少数托管 API 的转折点。它的紧凑检查点催生了指令微调、低秩适配、量化和广泛的开放模型生态，尽管原始权重采用面向研究的访问条款。
